title: The Black Lake Shore

location.name: Shore of the Black Lake
location.description: The caverns open onto the edge of a vast, still, black underground lake whose far shore is lost in darkness. A troglodyte shaman holds court here amid bone-fetishes. Somewhere out in that black water, something very large sometimes stirs.

read_aloud: The passage opens onto a shore of black sand at the edge of an underground lake so still and dark it looks like a hole in the world. You cannot see the far side. Bone-fetishes and a crude altar mark this as sacred ground to the troglodytes — and their shaman turns from the water to hiss at you. Far out on the lake, something breaks the surface with a slow, heavy ripple, then is gone.

enemies.special: One is the shaman — treat as a troglodyte with 20 HP that can cast a 1/day fear-hiss (DC 12 WIS or frightened 1 round).

enemies.position: swarming from crevices when blood is spilled

encounters.tactics: The shaman fights defensively near the altar, sending trogs and rats forward. IMPORTANT: loud combat or fire on the shore has a chance to draw Nightscale (see dm_notes) — the dragon may surface for one Acid Breath pass before submerging, a warning of what waits in Chapter 4. The shore is the last safe place to long-rest before the Foundry.
encounters.description: The troglodyte holy site. A hidden dwarven stair behind the altar descends to the Foundry (Chapter 3).

loot.location: an old dwarven corpse half-buried in the black sand, clutching them
the shaman's fetish-hoard at the altar

skill_checks.success: Find the concealed dwarven stair behind the altar leading down to the Foundry.
skill_checks.failure: The way deeper stays hidden — the party must search longer (risking a wandering encounter).

skill_checks.success: Recognize the ripples and acid-etched stones as signs of a black dragon lairing in the lake — forewarned for Chapter 4.

dm_notes: SCALING (6 PCs, +50%): 5 trogs incl. shaman + 6 giant rats. FORESHADOW Nightscale here — if the party is loud/uses fire, have the dragon surface for a single Acid Breath (30-ft line, DC 14, do NOT let it fully engage yet) then dive; this telegraphs the Chapter 4 boss and rewards a stealthy approach. This shore is the sanctioned long-rest point. 3+ interactables: the altar (topple for cover/relics), black sand (difficult terrain), the lake edge (creatures can be shoved in — deep water).
